source_provenance.authority_note: The imported document supplied construction pressure. This registry is governed by the construction specification and does not warrant any listed claim.

obligations.title: Contextual occurrence typing and composition
obligations.statement: CtxOcc(P,R,S) = S ∘ R ∘ P, with typed endpoints and occurrence identity retained.
obligations.decisive_check: Reject reversed composition, erased intermediate types, and collapse of contextual occurrence into value equality.

obligations.title: Question transport along a represented path
obligations.statement: C_q^P = C_q ∘ P for a compatible typed path, without introducing an inverse or a new primitive transport operator.
obligations.decisive_check: Reject endpoint mismatch, path-order reversal, inferred actuality, and reciprocal-as-inverse collapse.

obligations.title: Discriminator pullback composition
obligations.statement: (S ∘ R)^* K = R^*(S^* K) whenever the discriminator transport is well typed.
obligations.decisive_check: Prove from the retained transport definition or exhibit the smallest binding in which the proposed equality is ill typed or false.

obligations.title: Co-anchored meet
obligations.statement: For a simultaneous question set B, ~_B = ⋂(q in B) ~_q under one fixed anchor and applicability region.
obligations.decisive_check: Reject mixed anchors, hidden sequential updates, and empty-family conclusions stronger than the supplied binding licenses.

obligations.title: Forward distinction transport
obligations.statement: (D_K)_L = D_(L ∘ K) for the selected typed relational image definition.
obligations.decisive_check: Check the exact image convention and reject a proof that silently assumes functionality, totality, or inverse transport.

obligations.title: Condition-solution polarity
obligations.statement: W ⊆ Cond^X_Θ(S) iff S ⊆ Sol^X_W under the independently retained condition and solution definitions.
obligations.decisive_check: Pressure-test both directions, empty families, applicability, and typed evaluation without collapsing polarity into path transport.

obligations.title: Co-anchored versus sequential noncollapse
obligations.statement: Simultaneous co-anchored refinement need not represent answer-conditioned sequential inquiry.
obligations.decisive_check: Provide a finite typed model in which the simultaneous profile and at least one sequential update have protected-different consequences.

obligations.title: Three-way arrangement distinction
obligations.statement: Q_(B∪C), U_C ∘ U_B, and U_B ∘ U_C remain pairwise distinct where a binding exposes the distinctions.
obligations.decisive_check: Witness each claimed separation independently and retain typed inapplicability where a composition is unavailable.

obligations.title: Reciprocal section is not an inverse
obligations.statement: A use-indexed reciprocal return section, a converse, and an inverse are not generally identical.
obligations.decisive_check: Use a many-to-many relation with a plural return fiber and reject selected-return or endpoint equality as inversion evidence.

obligations.title: Adjacent-order localization
obligations.statement: Protectedly different lawful finite orderings connected by lawful adjacent swaps contain at least one adjacent swap that changes the protected consequence.
obligations.decisive_check: Distinguish semantic difference from a typing-blocked swap and state the connectivity and finiteness premises explicitly.

obligations.title: Path-sensitive answer section
obligations.statement: Equal answer values do not imply equal answer occurrences, paths, environments, support, or continuations.
obligations.decisive_check: Construct equal endpoint values with protected-different path-indexed continuations.

obligations.title: Three-way arrangement operational realization
obligations.statement: The simultaneous and two sequential arrangements elaborate to distinct well-typed programs whose denotations preserve the Gate D separations when applicable.
obligations.decisive_check: Require structural bind and operational semantics; a syntax-only distinction is insufficient.

obligations.title: Pure closure laws
obligations.statement: The admitted pure closure operator is extensive, monotone, idempotent, and compatible with its declared incremental closure operation.
obligations.decisive_check: State the carrier, order, regime, and incremental operation; do not infer semantic or effectful closure from a pure operator.

obligations.title: Bounded fixed-regime stabilization
obligations.statement: A finite admitted fixed regime stabilizes under the checked closure operator within an explicit bound.
obligations.decisive_check: Require finite carrier/regime and unchanged operator; reject an unbounded, effectful, or dynamically expanding generalization.

obligations.title: Protected compression factorization
obligations.statement: A fold c is exact for protected family H only when every D in H factors as D = D_hat ∘ c with retained ancestry, coverage, and regeneration evidence.
obligations.decisive_check: Reject selected-sample agreement, endpoint equality, or missing continuations as sufficient factorization evidence.

obligations.title: Historical reopening under a transported discriminator
obligations.statement: A supported later discriminator that does not factor through an earlier fold invalidates exactness relative to the enlarged protected family and reopens the folded ancestry.
obligations.decisive_check: Distinguish failed factorization search (Unknown) from a supported separation, and require exact fold/discriminator ancestry.

obligations.title: Regenerative irredundancy
obligations.statement: Every retained consequential distinction has a protected consequence or an explicit unresolved ablation obligation, including joint ablations.
obligations.decisive_check: Reject singleton-only minimality, unproved necessity, and deletion of ancestry or reopening conditions.

obligations.title: Canonical render-elaborate round trip
obligations.statement: elab(render(q)) ≡ q for every admitted canonical question category, with the exact equality level stated.
obligations.decisive_check: Check notation and canonical prose separately; do not extend the result to arbitrary free prose.

obligations.title: Linear discriminator pullback
obligations.statement: For linear P and q in a lawful finite-dimensional linear binding, q_eff = P^T q.
obligations.decisive_check: Type all spaces and duals and reject promotion to universal calculus structure.

obligations.title: Linear contextual pullback composition
obligations.statement: For a lawful linear contextual composite S ∘ R ∘ P, q_eff = P^T R^T S^T q.
obligations.decisive_check: Check transpose order, dimensions, and correspondence with the general typed pullback theorem.

obligations.title: Protected adjacent-order discriminator
obligations.statement: The adjacent order difference observed by q is q^T S(BA-AB)Px; BA ≠ AB alone does not imply protected order difference.
obligations.decisive_check: Prove the displayed difference and exhibit noncommuting A,B whose commutator is invisible to the supplied protected observation.

obligations.title: Lawful self-reentry
obligations.statement: Reified inquiry products may re-enter ordinary typed inquiry without obtaining actuality, warrant, or standing from self-application.
obligations.decisive_check: Require explicit universe/type stratification and reject self-warrant, hidden quotation collapse, and total reification.

obligations.title: Proof-presupposition recursion
obligations.statement: Every consequential theorem exposes a typed Requires relation to premises recursively classified to the declared ambient metalanguage boundary.
obligations.decisive_check: Separate definitions, prior theorems, binding assumptions, predecessor obligations, actuality, evidence, and hidden prose assumptions; do not ask the calculus to regenerate Lean.

obligations.title: Regenerative successor equivalence
obligations.statement: If checked successor C1 regenerates as C1', then C1' ≡_(H_C) C1 without consulting the historical construction scaffold.
obligations.decisive_check: Delete the historical scaffold in an isolated reconstruction, regenerate, and check the declared protected equivalence with independent evidence.
